intro.title: WHAT IS SHINOBI BOMBERS?
intro.lead: A strategy-focused ninja game: collect Shinobi heroes, build your team and send them through stage-based adventures.
intro.f1.d: Six ranks — Genin, Chunin, Jonin, Elite, Legend and the limited Mythic — each with its own stats, perks and attacks.
intro.f2.d: Summon new heroes at the Shrine with published odds: Genin 60%, Chunin 25%, Jonin 10%, Elite 4%, Legend 1%.
intro.f3.d: Train heroes up to level 5, and fuse three heroes of the same rank for a chance at the next rank.
intro.f4.d: Deploy your team across eight Adventure maps and fight through stage after stage.
intro.f5.d: Send your five strongest heroes against powerful bosses and climb the daily and weekly rankings.
intro.f6.d: Trade heroes on the player Market, upgrade your Dojo and hire a Sensei to manage your team.
intro.note: Every game feature opens at the official launch. Until then, the game server stays closed.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Do I need to pay or deposit to register?
faq.a1: No. Connecting your wallet and registering are free. You only sign a message — no transaction is sent and no funds move.
faq.a2: Phantom, Solflare and other Solana wallets that support message signing (Wallet Standard).
faq.q3: Will I need to register again at launch?
faq.a3: No. Your account, username and referral link carry over to the live game.
faq.a4: After the official launch, when a player you invited summons 15 heroes and clears Stage 5. You can then claim 2 random heroes.
faq.q5: Can I sell referral reward heroes?
faq.a5: No. They're permanently bound to your account. Use them in battles and progression, but they can't be listed, sold or transferred.
faq.q6: Can I change who referred me?
faq.a6: No. A referral is permanent once your account is registered, and you can't refer yourself.
faq.q7: Will you ever ask for my seed phrase?
faq.a7: Never. Shinobi Bombers never asks for your seed phrase or private key. Anyone who does is a scammer.

rules.title: Referral Program Rules
rules.lead: How the Shinobi Bombers Referral Program works, before and after the official launch.
rules.items: Every registered player gets one permanent personal referral link.
A player can be referred only once. The referrer is set when the invited player registers and can never be changed.
You can't refer yourself, and referral chains can't loop back (for example A → B → A).
Referral links are for new players. Accounts that already made a purchase or Adventure progress can't be referred.
Link clicks and wallet connections don't count. Only registered accounts count as invited.

A referral qualifies when the invited player, after the official launch, (1) completes 15 paid hero summons at the Summoning Shrine and (2) clears Stage 5 in Adventure. Both are verified by the game server. Free, starter and reward heroes don't count toward the 15.
Each qualified referral gives the referrer 2 hero passes. Claiming a pass summons one random hero with the Summoning Shrine's official odds. Claiming opens at the official launch.

Referral reward heroes — and heroes fused from them — are permanently bound to your account. They can be used in battles, teams and training, but they can't be listed on the Market, sold or transferred.
Referral rewards are in-game heroes only. They are not SOL, tokens or withdrawable coins.
Fake accounts, automated sign-ups or referral farming can lead to rewards being withheld. Enrollment can be paused or capped; referrals already accepted keep their rewards.
The leaderboard ranks registered referrals for fun. Placement gives no extra prize.
privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.draft: This notice describes the pre-launch portal. It will be reviewed before the official launch.
privacy.store: Your username, language and preferred server region.
Who referred you and who you referred, with dates.
Whether you appear on the referral leaderboard.
A sign-in session for up to one hour (a random token, stored only as a one-way hash).
Audit records of important account actions, such as registration and referral attribution.
privacy.neverTitle: What we never ask for or store
privacy.never: Email address, phone number, real name or home address.
privacy.tech: Your IP address is used briefly in memory to limit abuse (rate limiting). It isn't written to our database. Our hosting provider may keep standard request logs.
One essential, HttpOnly sign-in cookie, valid for one hour. No advertising or tracking cookies.
Your language, Comfort mode and a referral code from a link you opened (for 7 days) are saved in your browser's local storage.
privacy.share: Your username can appear on the public referral leaderboard (you can hide it in your dashboard).
Players you invited see your username; you see theirs.
Your full wallet address is never shown publicly.
privacy.choices: Change your language, region and leaderboard visibility in your dashboard.
To ask for a copy or deletion of your account data, contact support.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.draft: DRAFT — to be reviewed before launch. These draft terms will be replaced by the final Terms of Service before the official launch.
terms.items: This is a pre-launch registration service. The game, Market, summoning and all payments are not available yet.
Registration is free and needs only a wallet signature. No transaction is sent.
You're responsible for the security of your wallet. We will never ask for your seed phrase or private key.
One account per wallet. Usernames must not impersonate others or be offensive; we may change or remove such usernames.
Referral rewards follow the Referral Program Rules and may be withheld in cases of abuse.
Features, dates and rewards described before launch may change. No launch date is guaranteed.
Referral rewards are in-game items only, with no cash value.
